artworks.label: Aurora seal
artworks.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. ONE new original standalone Glaze small-widget illustration for aurora-haven. Square 1024 x 1024. Subject: A serene Arctic seal pup carved from frosted translucent ice, tucked foreflippers and gently lifted face, tiny dark natural eyes, flowing emerald and turquoise aurora ribbons with a very subtle violet fringe glowing INSIDE the icy body, delicately frosted whiskers. One small low snow ledge below the seal; everything isolated as one collectible sculpture. Style: Premium photoreal fantasy ice sculpture, realistic frost microcrystals and translucent blue ice, dark-teal reflected shadows. Match a deep Arctic teal night wallpaper and existing frosted aurora mushrooms, aurora bottle, sleeping fox and crystal prism; create a new seal subject, not any of those objects. Composition: whole subject centered, clear readable silhouette at small iPhone size, 15 percent clear margins, soft upper-left lighting. True transparent background, alpha preserved; no opaque tile, hard rectangular frame, scenery or collage. Pure art only: absolutely NO text, lettering, numerals, dates, calendar, clock hands, dial, UI, logo or watermark. No copy, crop or recolour of any existing piece.
artworks.processing: Resize entire original square to 1024x1024; WebP q92 method6; alpha preserved; no crop, recolour or subject edits.
artworks.visualReview: Reviewed against wallpaper and all current pure-art subjects; distinct subject, matching style/palette, no text or live-value imagery.
